text:
Welcome to Cafe Giang, or Cà phê Giảng, a historic coffee shop located at 39 Nguyen Huu Huan Street. This cafe is famous for its unique and delicious egg coffee, which is served in a delightful cup sitting in warm water, ensuring the perfect temperature and consistency. Apart from egg coffee, you can also try its egg cocoa and egg rum, making it a fantastic spot for coffee enthusiasts and those looking for something a bit different.

You will find that the drinks here range from about 25,000 to 50,000 VND, making it an affordable treat. The cafe opens early at 7:00 AM and stays open until around 10:00 PM, though closing times may vary; some sources suggest it can stay open until 11:30 PM, so it's a good idea to check before you go.

If you're looking for a cozy atmosphere to enjoy a unique beverage, Cafe Giang is a must-visit spot in Hanoi. Don't forget to indulge in their specialties while soaking in the charm of this long-established establishment!
